description: Activate when: user says 'we've come too far to quit', 'we can't waste what we've already spent', 'should I keep going or cut my losses', 'we've invested too much to stop now', 'should I continue this project / relationship / position'. Do NOT activate when: prior investment genuinely lowers future marginal costs (real synergies exist); user asks about loss-aversion psychology in general without a concrete continue-or-quit decision. More: deciqai.com/c/sunk-cost-fallacy
